• Newsletter (Saltmarsh Foods, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026"): This week's edition covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to the full blog article and a companion piece.
• Article (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data — and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
• Companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/cold-chain/companion, accessed via registration with jonas.moreau@northwind.example): Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
